{"id":1948003181,"question_id":4253,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 1 week","timestamp":1773499170,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"131 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1948003181/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Cost to Equalize Arrays Using Swaps","memory":"254.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minCost(vector<int>& nums1, vector<int>& nums2) {\n        int n = nums1.size();\n        unordered_map<int,int>mp;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            mp[nums1[i]]++;\n            mp[nums2[i]]--;\n        }\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        for(auto it : mp){\n            if(abs(it.second) % 2 != 0) return -1;\n            if(it.second > 0) ans += it.second / 2;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-cost-to-equalize-arrays-using-swaps","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1836}
